pages.text: The $(l)Hay Farmer$() is a basic land helper. While simpler than his Gnome cousins, he moves with a bit more $(b)speed$() and is dedicated to keeping your crops growing tall.

pages.title: Farming Operations
pages.text: $(b)Equip him with shears$() to start. He will:$(li)$(6)Harvest$() grown crops.$(li)$(6)Replant$() seeds.$(li)$(6)Apply bone meal$() to accelerate growth.$(li)$(6)Store$() items in chest.

pages.title: Chest Assignment
pages.text: Use the $(b)Toy Command Staff$() to assign a storage chest:$(li)$(6)Shift + Right Click$() on the chest to set its position.$(li)$(6)Shift + Right Click$() again to confirm the assignment.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 10$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 0$(br2)$(c)Notice:$() He moves $(b)slightly faster$() than a Gnome but remains $(b)strictly peaceful$(). Ensure his safety!
Assembled from dried hay and basic farming tools for reliable field work.
